title: The Arrival of Java 26 | java
snippet:
Performance Advancements

JEP 522: G1 GC: Improve Throughput by Reducing Synchronization

Helps developers process more work in less time by improving memory efficiency. It reduces the synchronization between application and garbage collector threads, increasing throughput with the G1 garbage collector. By running faster and supporting more users without additional hardware, Java improves efficiency, lowers infrastructure costs, and delivers a smoother user experience.
